title: Player invulnerable to threat enemy contact
explanation: state_snapshot event at frame 300 shows the closest enemy (is_threat=true) at x=1886.6, y=800.0, which is 79.98 units from the player (dx<80) and y-difference 0.02 (<82), so contact occurs; stats.deaths remains 0 in that snapshot. No player_died, player_hurt, or player_damaged events are present in any later event (session_end at frame 350). Thus the player takes no damage despite threat contact.
